use_case_summary: SMB support automation platform wants Hosted API to power: (1) ticket summarization (2–3 line concise summaries), (2) structured JSON output with enforced schema for fields: priority, category, suggested_assignee, escalation_flag, (3) function/tool calling to open/update tickets in their HelpStack instance and query order status, (4) lightweight embeddings for similarity search for KB articles. Targets: median latency <250ms for chat generation, throughput ~50 concurrent requests during peak, cost-sensitive (budget ~ $500–1,000/mo initially). Preference for curated open models or Redwood-verified small LLMs to manage token cost. Security: require SSO for console, SOC2 proof, and option to disable KV caching for EU traffic. POC success metrics: summary accuracy >80% (human eval), structured output schema adherence >95%, and end-to-end update to ticket system via tool call in demo.
